messages:
anna: Heads-up: prototype for a "Presets" + bulk apply flow for Capacity. Goal: let teams save common configs (min/max/burst/SLO) and safely apply to multiple pools. Mock: https://redwood.design/s/presets-bulk-v2 :sparkles: miles: Nice. Two safety concerns: previewing diffs before apply and handling incompatible pools (CPU-only vs GPU). We need a clear disabled state + reason. ashley: Prototype idea: top-left dropdown for presets. Selecting a preset opens a compact diff panel at bottom showing per-selected-pool rows: "web-prod: Min 2 → 4 | Burst off → 20m | SLO 90% → 95%". Inline icons (chevrons) + accessible text. peng: Accessibility notes: rows must be keyboard navigable. Use a `role=list` and `role=listitem`. Each diff cell should expose `aria-label` like "web-prod: min increases from 2 to 4". For incompatible pools, show a non-focusable grey row with `aria-disabled=true` and a descriptive tooltip. anna: Copy question: header text for the diff panel. Options: A) "Preview changes" B) "Review preset changes" C) "Preview and confirm" Which is clearest? miles: B reads well within the product. Short but explicit. ashley: Also adding an "Apply dry-run" toggle to simulate changes and show estimated scaling events without committing. Helpful for ops. Dry-run should be clearly labeled and available in the confirm modal. peng: Keyboard shortcuts: allow multi-select with Shift+click or Space to select rows, then `P` opens presets. Within the diff panel, arrow keys move between rows, Enter expands details for a pool. Announce selection counts with a live region: `
3 pools selected, 2 compatible
`. anna: Cost guardrails: if preset would increase max > 2x or add GPUs where none existed, show a warning chip: "Large scale-up — estimated cost +$X/day" and an `Estimate cost` link to a modal. The warning needs short copy for the chip and longer CTA text in the modal. miles: Telemetry/security: emit events `preset.preview_opened`, `preset.apply_confirmed`, `preset.incompatible_skipped`. Only `capacity.admin` can create/edit presets; anyone with `capacity.editor` can apply presets but must pass a 2-step confirm if cost > threshold. ashley: Visual accessibility: don't rely on color. Use icons (up/down chevrons) and text like "+2" or "→ 4". Ensure contrast for the warning chip meets 4.5:1. I'll test color combos. peng: Screen reader nit: when the diff panel opens, focus should move to the first diff row and the panel should have `role=dialog` to trap focus. Also, when applying to multiple pools, announce the operation result summary: `aria-live="polite"` text: "Applied preset to 3 pools. 2 succeeded, 1 incompatible." anna: Edge-case: when a preset references a model/instance-type not available to the project, we should surface a replacement suggestion: "No A100 in project — use closest equivalent: V100 (apply?)". Default behavior should be conservative — do not auto-convert without explicit opt-in. miles: UX pattern for replacement: show a small inline checkbox in the confirm modal: `Convert incompatible pools to closest match` with explanatory microcopy. Default off. ashley: Mock variants request: 1) Inline diff rail at bottom (compact) 2) Modal diff with full rows + compatibility filters. Also a secondary compact mode that only shows the summary per pool to reach density target. peng: Accessibility checklist for implementation: aria labels, focus management, live regions, keyboard shortcuts, contrast verification, tooltip `role=tooltip` for reasons. I'll produce a small spec snippet for devs. ux-bot: density heuristic: compact rail reduces row height from ~60px to target 48px. Contrast scan scheduled for 2026-04-05T15:00Z. anna: Actions: Ashley to post two mock variants by Wednesday AM, Miles to draft telemetry & RBAC rules, Peng to publish the a11y snippet, Anna to write the cost warning copy. Deadline EOD Friday. ashley: On it — will upload frames + short Loom and mark up a11y callouts. miles: I'll write the telemetry list and threshold rules today. peng: Spec snippet will be in the next message. ux-bot: reminder scheduled: density + contrast checks will post results here when complete.
